items.name: Opium Spa
items.summary: Indulge in a luxurious pampering experience at Opium Spa with their Serenity at the Siam package. This 240-minute treatment features Himalayan salt exfoliation, a soothing steam session, and a full-body massage using premium Sodashi oils. Complete your visit with a rejuvenating French clay body mask and thermal infusion facial for ultimate relaxation.

items.name: Sukhothai Spa
items.summary: Sukhothai Spa offers a luxurious escape with indulgent packages that include deluxe accommodations and wellness treatments. Experience their signature 60-minute massage, which features a foot treatment, or elevate your stay with a bath ritual. Perfect for those seeking relaxation in an upscale setting.

items.name: Auriga at Cappella
items.summary: Auriga at Cappella offers a calm and sophisticated spa experience, perfect for those seeking relaxation. Attention to detail is evident in their luxurious treatments, from traditional Thai massages to the extravagant Ultimate Couple Hydrosense package. With prices ranging from B800 to B20,000, this spa caters to various preferences while ensuring quality service.

evidence: Ultimate Couple Hydrosense includes every luxury-based spa treatment
High-tech Hydrafacial sessions start at just B4,800

items.name: Peace Oriental Teahouse (Ekkamai flagship)
items.summary: Peace Oriental Teahouse is a serene haven for Japanese tea enthusiasts, featuring design-led spaces and a focus on ceremonial matcha. Staff expertly guide guests through the nuances of whisking and tasting, creating a mindful experience. This teahouse offers a calm refuge ideal for focused tea sessions.

evidence: staff guiding whisk thickness and temperature

items.name: Rarinjinda
items.summary: Rarinjinda offers a luxurious spa experience with three distinct massage options, each designed to rejuvenate the body and mind. The standout RarinJinda royal touch combines multiple relaxing treatments for a comprehensive pampering session. Pricing ranges from B1,700 for the aromatherapy oil massage to B5,600 for the ultimate royal touch.

evidence: RarinJinda royal touch includes multiple treatments

items.name: D’ARK
items.summary: D’ARK ICONSIAM offers a cozy spot for coffee lovers, showcasing meticulous service and an inviting ambiance. Known for its espresso drinks and manual brewing methods, the café features a charming view of the river. Perfect for a quick coffee break or a relaxed meeting, it ensures consistent quality and friendly service.

items.name: Infinity
items.summary: Infinity offers a rejuvenating escape with its signature Thai and aromatherapy massages. The 60-minute aroma treatment is priced at B1,300, while the 90-minute deep tissue option, designed to relieve muscle tension, costs B1,600. Experience improved energy flow and relaxation in a serene environment.

items.name: Harnn Spa
items.summary: Harnn Spa invites relaxation in a serene setting adorned with modern Thai decor and ample natural light. Experience the Pranakorn therapy, a 60-minute traditional Thai massage that blends yoga-like movements to enhance mobility and relieve muscle tension. Additional treatments include aromatherapy, acupuncture, and reflexology.

items.name: Happy & Healthy Bike Lane
items.summary: A purpose-built cycling and running complex surrounds Suvarnabhumi Airport, providing a scenic 23–25 km loop. With bike rentals, controlled access, and amenities, it caters to both cyclists and runners seeking uninterrupted exercise. Evening sessions are well-lit, ensuring safety and comfort for all users.

items.name: Riverdale Golf Club
items.summary: Riverdale Golf Club offers a stunning golfing experience on a modern course shaped by the unique landscape of a former sand quarry. Known for its pristine conditions and challenging, photogenic holes, it caters to both casual players and serious golfers alike. The contemporary clubhouse and practice range enhance the overall experience, making it a perfect choice for golf enthusiasts near Bangkok.

evidence: modern course carved into a former sand quarry

items.name: Science Centre for Education
items.summary: Experience the wonders of science at Bangkok's oldest planetarium, featuring interactive exhibits in astronomy and biology. Affordable ticketing makes it ideal for families and students alike, with scheduled shows in both Thai and English. Seasonal programs introduce new films and engaging workshops, perfect for school groups or casual visitors.

items.name: Chao Phraya Sky Park
items.summary: Chao Phraya Sky Park offers a unique elevated path with stunning skyline views over the Chao Phraya River. Ideal for light jogs, photo walks, and urban cycling, it invites visitors to relax on benches while enjoying sunset vistas. As Southeast Asia's first sky park, it exemplifies Bangkok's commitment to pedestrian-friendly infrastructure.

evidence: first sky park of its kind in Southeast Asia
stunning skyline views over the Chao Phraya River

items.name: Nahm — 1 star
items.summary: Sophisticated Thai cuisine awaits at Nahm, a MICHELIN-starred restaurant known for its layered flavors. The elegant space complements robust curries and delicate relishes, all served with attentive service. Reservations are recommended to experience their premium tasting and à la carte options.

items.name: Kate's Place - Supper Club
items.summary: A hidden gem in a stylish shophouse, Kate's Place offers an intimate dining experience with a monthly changing set menu featuring Thai comfort food. Signature dishes like beef panang and steamed red snapper highlight a blend of traditional flavors with a modern twist. Perfect for private gatherings, the space accommodates up to 12 guests, making it an exclusive culinary escape.

evidence: intimate space hidden behind a bookshelf
private dining for up to 12 people

items.name: Potong
items.summary: Amid the vibrant chaos of Sampeng, Potong offers an innovative 20-course dinner that reimagines Thai-Chinese cuisine. Each dish is a sensory journey, from whimsical presentations like the orange tree dessert to expertly crafted cocktails in a unique opium bar setting. A carefully curated wine selection complements the culinary adventure, making every visit a reason to return.

items.name: Wana Yook — 1 star
items.summary: Wana Yook, a MICHELIN-starred restaurant, offers a unique exploration of Thai rice and its cultural significance. The carefully curated courses highlight regional grains paired with traditional accompaniments, all presented in a contemporary setting. With a focus on narrative menus and attentive service, this dining experience is perfect for those seeking an authentic taste of Thailand.

items.name: Chai
items.summary: Chai stands out as a MICHELIN-listed gem, specializing in Thai-Chinese rice and noodle dishes. The menu emphasizes clean, slightly sweet sauces and reliable quality, making it a local favorite for fast meals. With counter seating and a bustling atmosphere, this spot is perfect for a quick yet satisfying dining experience.

items.name: Aunglo by Yangrak
items.summary: Aunglo by Yangrak impresses with its MICHELIN-listed Thai cuisine in a modern bistro setting. Seasonal, herb-forward dishes are complemented by a selection of cocktails and local spirits, making it ideal for date nights or small gatherings. Friendly service and vibrant plating enhance the dining experience, though reservations are recommended during peak hours.

items.name: Aksorn — 1 star
items.summary: Aksorn, a MICHELIN-starred restaurant, offers a unique take on Thai cuisine inspired by mid-20th-century cookbooks. Each dish is crafted with heritage flavors and thoughtful sourcing, accompanied by narratives that enrich the dining experience. The warm ambiance and premium pricing cater to those who appreciate culinary history.

evidence: Menu formats may be fixed or short à la carte
Service provides context for each course’s history

items.name: Thipsamai
items.summary: Thipsamai stands out as a legendary Pad Thai destination, celebrated in the MICHELIN Guide. Signature sun-dried noodles and prawn oil create an unforgettable dish, especially the superb version with grilled prawns wrapped in egg. Expect long queues during evenings, making it a must-visit for any Pad Thai enthusiast.

evidence: queues are common in the evening

items.name: Sae Phun
items.summary: Sae Phun offers a delightful mix of Thai-Chinese comfort food recognized by the MICHELIN Guide as a Bib Gourmand pick. The menu features braised meats and herbal rice dishes, providing a solid value for local office workers during lunch hours. With brisk service and straightforward seating, this spot is perfect for a quick takeaway near the old town.

evidence: solid value choice near the old town

items.name: Nawa Central Thai Cuisine
items.summary: Nawa Central Thai Cuisine offers a refined dining experience where traditional Thai flavors meet contemporary presentation. The vibrant atmosphere, marked by dark walls and an open kitchen, creates a unique backdrop for an impressive 14-course tasting menu. Dishes like tom yum koong and wagyu panang highlight the chefs' expertise while maintaining comforting elements of Thai cuisine.

items.name: Sompong Thai Cooking School
items.summary: Sompong Thai Cooking School offers immersive cooking classes that combine a market tour with hands-on culinary experiences. Participants learn to create authentic Thai dishes like Pad Thai and Tom Yum while mastering key techniques under expert supervision. With manageable group sizes and vegetarian options available, this school is perfect for anyone wanting to deepen their culinary skills in a vibrant setting.

evidence: individual cooking stations under chef supervision
menus rotate to cover popular recipes

items.name: Sorn (Sukhumvit 26)
items.summary: Experience Southern-Thai cuisine at Sorn, where every dish is a masterpiece crafted with precision and rare ingredients. The moody townhouse setting enhances the choreography of service, ensuring a memorable dining experience. Reservations are essential, often requiring a month in advance due to its exclusivity.

items.name: Above Eleven
items.summary: Experience the vibrant fusion of Peruvian and Japanese cuisine at Above Eleven, a rooftop bar with stunning panoramic views of Bangkok. Sip on zesty pisco sours and indulge in dishes like ceviche and South American grilled platters while enjoying the sleek design inspired by Central Park. This fashionable venue offers a unique atmosphere with neon lights and even a bathroom boasting cityscape views.

items.name: Red Sky
items.summary: Bangkok's nightlife shines at Red Sky, a top-rated rooftop bar known for its vibrant atmosphere and diverse weekly parties. Guests can indulge in delicious food and expertly crafted drinks while enjoying stunning city views. The venue continues to innovate, making it a must-visit for both locals and travelers alike.

evidence: top spot from the BAD Awards
weekly parties called 'Nights at the Yard'
good mixture of vibes and energy levels

items.name: Ojo (Silom/Mahanakhon 76F)
items.summary: Experience modern Mexican cuisine at Ojo, a stunning rooftop venue in Bangkok with sweeping skyline views. Chef Paco Ruano elevates traditional dishes in a chic, geometric setting, perfect for sunset cocktails and dinner. Reservations are recommended to secure prime seating in this stylish space.

items.name: ABar Rooftop
items.summary: ABar Rooftop stands out in Bangkok's nightlife, consistently topping the BAD Awards for rooftop bars. The venue has recently introduced 'Nights at the Yard', a series of vibrant weekly parties that cater to diverse crowds. With excellent food and drink offerings, it promises an unforgettable experience under the stars.

evidence: top spot from the BAD Awards

items.name: Lennon’s
items.summary: Lennon’s at Rosewood Bangkok offers a luxurious listening lounge experience, showcasing a vast collection of 6,000 records in an elegant setting. The curated music selection ranges from jazz to soft rock, complemented by cocktails inspired by musical legends. With stunning skyline views and impeccable service, this venue is perfect for both romantic dates and music enthusiasts.

items.name: Onggi
items.summary: Onggi, meaning earthenware in Korean, showcases authentic fermented ingredients in a fine dining atmosphere. Located on the 55th floor of Empire Tower, it offers stunning views paired with exquisite dishes. Injin Kim's passion project invites you to indulge in a unique culinary experience that is both traditional and elevated.

items.name: Nobu Bangkok (Sathorn/Empire)
items.summary: Experience the luxury of Nobu Bangkok, where Japanese-Peruvian cuisine meets stunning city views from the rooftop. This elegant venue offers signature dishes amidst a sleek interior perfect for special occasions. Reservations are recommended to ensure an unforgettable dining experience.

items.name: Nobu Bangkok
items.summary: Nobu Bangkok offers a sophisticated dining experience with skyline views and a blend of Japanese-Peruvian cuisine. Signature dishes like yellowtail jalapeño and black cod are complemented by Thai-inspired specials and an extensive sake selection. The sleek design and vibrant atmosphere make it perfect for celebrations, especially when booked at a window table.

items.name: Lennon’s (Rosewood Bangkok)
items.summary: Lennon’s at Rosewood Bangkok offers an enchanting experience with its impressive 6,000-record library and mid-century glamour. Enjoy a curated selection of music, from jazz to soft rock, alongside expertly crafted cocktails that pay homage to musical legends. This luxurious lounge is perfect for a romantic date or a unique outing for audiophiles seeking a memorable skyline view.

items.name: Scarlett Wine Bar & Restaurant
items.summary: Scarlett Wine Bar & Restaurant offers a delightful escape high above Silom, boasting stunning river views. Guests can indulge in expertly prepared French comfort food and chargrilled Aussie steaks, complemented by an extensive wine selection. Reservations are essential to secure a spot on the inviting terrace.

items.name: Red Sky — Chef’s Seasonal Menu
items.summary: A dining experience at Red Sky offers spectacular skyline views paired with a seasonal menu that enhances each moment. As golden hour approaches, the ambiance shifts from warm gold to vibrant neon, perfectly complementing the dishes. Service is attentive and smart-casual attire is recommended for this memorable outing.

evidence: seasonal menu that enhances each moment

items.name: Mezzaluna — 2 stars
items.summary: Mezzaluna offers an exquisite dining experience highlighted by two MICHELIN stars and stunning skyline views. Seasonal tasting menus showcase contemporary European cuisine, crafted with precision and luxury ingredients. A curated wine selection enhances the meal, making advance reservations essential for preferred seating.

evidence: two‑star listing in the MICHELIN Guide
curated wine program complements the menu
